title: Objective 5 doesn't start
symptom: User completed objectives 1-4 and verified them, but objective 5 did not start. This situation lasted for about 7 days. The issue persisted across reinstallations and an upgrade to version 3.0.0.2.
cause: The user had not verified objectives 1-4; they needed to click the verify button on each objective.
fix: The user needed to verify objectives 1-4 by clicking the verify button on each. After doing so, objective 5 started.
